# Brand Builder

> AI-powered LinkedIn pipeline generator that turns founder expertise into voice-matched posts on a 30-day plan.

Brand Builder helps founders and B2B executives build their personal brand on LinkedIn. It captures their voice from writing samples, ingests company context from a website and source materials (pitch decks, business plans), and generates a customized strategy brief plus a 4-week content calendar of drafted posts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Sign in or create an account to start building your LinkedIn pipeline.
- [Sign in](/auth): Authenticate with email or Google to access the app.
